settings.title: Global Font
settings.description: Configure a custom font applied across the admin and front-end.
settings.notice: The font set here applies identically to both the admin and the front-end. Deactivating the plugin reverts to the template's default font (Pretendard).
settings.upload_success: Font file uploaded. Press Save below to apply it.
settings.upload_error: Failed to upload the font file.

source_type.label: Font Source
source_type.hint: Choose whether to use an uploaded font file or external webfont CSS.

font_family_name.label: Font Family Name
font_family_name.hint: The font-family name referenced in CSS. For webfonts it must exactly match the name the webfont defines.

webfont_css.label: Webfont CSS Code
webfont_css.hint: CSS injected verbatim in webfont mode. Paste the whole @font-face block provided by services like noonnu.
webfont_css.note_google: If you only have a CSS URL like Google Fonts, wrap it as @import url('address');.
webfont_css.note_family: The Font Family Name above must exactly match the font-family value in the pasted CSS for the font to actually apply.

font_file.label: Font File
font_file.hint: Supports otf, ttf, woff, woff2. Max 10MB.

guide.title: How to use
guide.step1: Pick a font source. Choose 'Upload font file' to upload a file directly, or 'Webfont CSS code' to use an external webfont such as noonnu or Google Fonts.
guide.step2: Enter the font family name, then upload a font file or paste the webfont CSS code (an @font-face block or @import) depending on the source.
guide.step3: Press Save to apply the font across the admin and front-end. If the CSS fails to load or the family name differs from the CSS's font-family, it automatically falls back to the default font.
